source_batch.unit_label: BRBL::MOD_C::U06: Distinguish section19 compensation from automatic liability for every challenge

payload.title: The remedial finding matters
payload.core_explanation_md:
Section19 links the described compensation and costs to the relevant finding that possession was not in accordance with the Act/rules and a direction to return the secured assets. The amended text includes the qualifying other aggrieved person as well as the borrower. The tribunal or relevant court determines the amount under the applicable provision.

Filing a challenge does not itself prove unlawful possession or establish a fixed compensation percentage. Conversely,the remedy should not be erased by assuming that every creditor measure is immune from review. Preserve the measure,orders,restoration direction and claimed loss/cost evidence. Keep this remedy separate from the loss-of-office compensation exclusion in section16.

self_check.prompt_text: Does merely filing an application establish a section19 award?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. The statutory findings and order conditions must be met.

options.explanation_md: The source recognises a qualified remedy.

options.explanation_md: The remedy depends on the statutory conditions.
It does not establish the award.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The remedy depends on the statutory conditions.

payload.stem_md: A note uses section16 loss-of-office exclusion to deny every section19 unlawful-possession remedy. Which distinction is needed?

options.text_md: All compensation provisions mean the same thing
Loss-of-office exclusion and unlawful-possession compensation are separate provisions
options.explanation_md: Do not transplant one exclusion into another remedy.

options.text_md: Section19 never refers to an aggrieved person
options.explanation_md: The amended text must be read.

options.text_md: Only directors can challenge any measure

payload.correct_explanation_md: Do not transplant one exclusion into another remedy.
